title: Product Analyst
description: Join Us as a Product Analyst! Are you passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve customer experiences and operational performance? ORBCOMM is seeking a Product Analyst to support our Solutions Delivery organization by analyzing product, device, connectivity, and customer experience data to identify trends, resolve recurring issues, and drive continuous improvement across our solutions portfolio. Why You’ll Love Working Here In this role, you will play a key part in helping ORBCOMM deliver exceptional customer experiences by uncovering meaningful insights from operational and product data. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, and cross-functional teams to identify root causes, improve service performance, and support data-driven decision-making. This is a temporary full-time assignment based in Hyderabad, India, within our Solutions Delivery team. Location: Hyderabad, India This is a full-time, term-based assignment with an anticipated duration of 12 months. The role requires onsite coverage during the night shift (6:00 PM – 3:00 AM). What You’ll Do Product Performance Analysis Analyze Salesforce cases and operational data to identify recurring product, device, connectivity, platform, and customer experience issues. Track product-related support trends by customer, product, issue type, severity, RCA, resolution, and recurrence. Identify high-volume or high-impact issues requiring deeper investigation and escalation. Reporting & Business Intelligence Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Monitor key performance indicators and communicate findings to stakeholders through clear visualizations and presentations. Support data-driven decision-making through meaningful analysis and recommendations. Operational Excellence Evaluate customer communication and service interactions through calls, chats, and emails to monitor policy adherence and service quality. Analyze operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce escalations, and shorten resolution times. Support continuous improvement initiatives by providing actionable insights and measurable outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Support, and Operations teams to investigate issues and recommend solutions. Communicate findings, trends, and recommendations to stakeholders across the business. Support root cause analysis efforts and contribute to product and process improvement initiatives. Who You Are You are an analytical problem-solver who enjoys working with data to uncover insights and improve business outcomes. You have strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to translate complex information into actionable recommendations. If you have: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred. 3–5 years of experience in product analysis, business analysis, operations analysis, customer support analytics, or a related role. Experience analyzing customer, operational, and product performance data. Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Knowledge of Salesforce reporting, case management, and analytics. Experience identifying trends, performing root cause analysis, and developing actionable recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. ITIL certification preferred. Microsoft Power BI certification preferred. Experience in a similar product or technology-focused environment preferred. Ability to work fully onsite in Hyderabad, India. Availability to support a night shift schedule (6:00 PM – 3:00 AM). Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy. Then we want to meet you! The Benefits of Working Here A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally. How We Hire ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture. About Us At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com! Ready to Join Us? We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Associate, Early Careers — Engineering, Global Services & Support
description: Early Careers at SmartDocs: Show Us Who You Are Freshers and final-year students welcome · No experience required · Apply with a 2–3 minute phone video Who we are SmartDocs builds procurement, contract management and spend management software for public sector organizations: state agencies, toll road authorities, cities and utilities. Our customers use our platform to buy goods and services, manage contracts and pay suppliers responsibly with taxpayer money. We work on Java, Angular, SAP integrations and Azure, and we use AI tools every day in how we design, build and support our products. We're hiring a group of early-career people to grow into technical roles with us. We care far more about how you think, learn and communicate than about what's already on your resume. The three tracks We're hiring into three areas. You don't need to have everything figured out. Tell us what interests you, and we'll work out the best fit together. People can and do move between tracks as they grow. 1. Associate Developer You'll learn to build software the way it's increasingly being built: working alongside AI coding agents, reviewing and improving what they produce, and owning features end to end. Good fit if you like building things and want to write code for a living. 2. Global Services Analyst You'll help customers get SmartDocs up and running: understanding how their procurement and finance teams work, configuring the platform, testing, and doing some light development where needed. Good fit if you like technology and people roughly equally, and enjoy solving business problems. 3. Global Support Analyst You'll be the person customers turn to when something isn't working: investigating issues, finding root causes, fixing what you can and working with developers on the rest. Good fit if you like puzzles, are patient, and get satisfaction from making a problem go away. Who should apply Recent graduates or students in your final year of college A degree (or degree in progress) in engineering, computer science, IT, science, maths or a related field. If your degree is something else but you're genuinely technical, apply anyway and tell us why. Curious about how technology works, and willing to learn things nobody has taught you yet Clear communicator in English, spoken and written No work experience is needed. Really. How to apply: send us a 2–3 minute video Instead of a cover letter, we'd like to see and hear from you. Record a short video on your phone introducing yourself. No editing, no fancy setup, no special software. Just you, talking to us. This is not a technical test. We're not going to quiz you on code. We want to get a sense of who you are before we meet you. What to talk about Use these as a guide. You don't need to cover them in order, and you don't need to cover all of them. Who you are. Your name, where you're from, what you studied or are studying. Something you figured out on your own. A project, a problem you solved, something you taught yourself, something you built or fixed. It doesn't have to be technical or impressive. We want to hear how you approached it. Why SmartDocs, and why this kind of work. What draws you to it? Which track interests you most. Or tell us you're not sure yet and what you're weighing. Both are fine answers. One thing we wouldn't learn from your resume. A few tips Keep it between 2 and 3 minutes. Shorter is better than longer. Talk, don't read. Notes are fine, but please don't read from a script, whether you wrote it or an AI did. We want to hear you think. Find a quiet spot with decent light. Face a window rather than having it behind you. Hold your phone steady (propping it up works) and look at the camera. One take is fine. We'd rather see the real you than a polished performance. How to submit Upload your video to hr@smartdocs.ai Name the file: FirstName_LastName_Track.mp4 (for example, Priya_Sharma_Developer.mp4 , or _Undecided if you're not sure) Attach your resume (one page is plenty) Include your graduation year and a phone number we can reach you on What happens next We'll watch every video. If we'd like to take things forward, we'll invite you for a conversation with our team, followed by a short practical exercise based on the track you're interested in. We aim to get back to everyone within asap SmartDocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We're looking forward to meeting you.

description: Early Careers at SmartDocs: Show Us Who You Are Freshers and final-year students welcome · No experience required · Apply with a 2–3 minute phone video Who we are SmartDocs builds procurement, contract management and spend management software for public sector organizations: state agencies, toll road authorities, cities and utilities. People can and do move between tracks as they grow. 1. Associate Developer You'll learn to build software the way it's increasingly being built: working alongside AI coding agents, reviewing and improving what they produce, and owning features end to end. Good fit if you like building things and want to write code for a living. 2. Global Services Analyst You'll help customers get SmartDocs up and running: understanding how their procurement and finance teams work, configuring the platform, testing, and doing some light development where needed. Good fit if you like technology and people roughly equally, and enjoy solving business problems. 3. Global Support Analyst You'll be the person customers turn to when something isn't working: investigating issues, finding root causes, fixing what you can and working with developers on the rest. Good fit if you like puzzles, are patient, and get satisfaction from making a problem go away. Who should apply Recent graduates or students in your final year of college A degree (or degree in progress) in engineering, computer science, IT, science, maths or a related field. If your degree is something else but you're genuinely technical, apply anyway and tell us why. Curious about how technology works, and willing to learn things nobody has taught you yet Clear communicator in English, spoken and written No work experience is needed. Really. How to apply: send us a 2–3 minute video Instead of a cover letter, we'd like to see and hear from you. Record a short video on your phone introducing yourself. No editing, no fancy setup, no special software. Just you, talking to us. This is not a technical test. We're not going to quiz you on code. We want to get a sense of who you are before we meet you. What to talk about Use these as a guide. You don't need to cover them in order, and you don't need to cover all of them. Who you are. Your name, where you're from, what you studied or are studying. Something you figured out on your own. A project, a problem you solved, something you taught yourself, something you built or fixed. It doesn't have to be technical or impressive. We want to hear how you approached it. Why SmartDocs, and why this kind of work. What draws you to it? Which track interests you most. Or tell us you're not sure yet and what you're weighing. Notes are fine, but please don't read from a script, whether you wrote it or an AI did. We want to hear you think. Find a quiet spot with decent light. Face a window rather than having it behind you. Hold your phone steady (propping it up works) and look at the camera. One take is fine. We'd rather see the real you than a polished performance. If we'd like to take things forward, we'll invite you for a conversation with our team, followed by a short practical exercise based on the track you're interested in. We aim to get back to everyone within asap SmartDocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We're looking forward to meeting you.
